lines: Vyre opens faster still: the sign-in page loads only what it needs and is ready in about a quarter of a second.
Sharing is instant on a big Space: Share and Unshare answer in about a quarter of a second, and the change shows at once.
After a sync, Files and lists stay quick: access updates only what the sync changed.
Temporary access ends on time without slowing the server, however many records the Space holds.
A busy server keeps its logs without pausing: log lines are saved in small batches.
